title: Open Differential
text: 作为行星锥齿轮的差速器；输出 4 路；按 {Interpolation method} 指定方法 Flat；{Efficiency factors} 指定配置 Constant、{Input ambient temperature} 指定创建输入端口、{Crown wheel (ring gear) located} 指定冠状齿轮连接 To the left、{Carrier to drive shaft ratio, Ndiff} 指定比值、{Carrier inertia, Jd} 指定惯性 .1、{Carrier damping, bd} 指定阻尼 1e-3、{Axle 1 inertia, Jw1} 指定惯性 .1、{Axle 1 damping, bw1} 指定阻尼 1e-3、{Axle 2 inertia, Jw2} 指定惯性 .1、{Axle 2 damping, bw2} 指定阻尼 1e-3、{Axle 1 initial velocity, omegaw1o} 指定角速度、{Axle 2 initial velocity, omegaw2o} 指定角速度、{Constant efficiency factor, eta} 指定效率、{Efficiency lookup table, eta_tbl} 查找表 M -by- N -by、{Efficiency torque breakpoints, Trq_bpts} 指定扭矩断点、{Efficiency speed breakpoints, omega_bpts} 指定速度断点、{Efficiency temperature breakpoints, Temp_bpts} 指定温度断点、{Ambient temperature, Tamb} 指定环境温度，按实例取值。

params.name: Efficiency factors
params.values: 指定配置 Constant (default) | Driveshaft torque, speed and temperature

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: 方法 Flat | Nearest | Linear point-slope | Linear Lagrange | Cubic spline

params.name: Input ambient temperature
params.values: 创建输入端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Crown wheel (ring gear) located
params.values: 指定冠状齿轮连接 To the left of center-line (default) | To the right of center-line

params.name: Carrier to drive shaft ratio, Ndiff
Efficiency lookup table, eta_tbl
params.values: 查找表 M -by- N -by- L array
